body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> The 2009 International CES, the world's largest tradeshow for consumer technology, today takes place in Las Vegas, January 8-11, 2009.

"With 2,700 exhibitors, including 300 new technology companies, spanning 1.7 million net square feet of exhibit space, the products introduced at this year's CES will change the shape of our industry and energize the global economy," said Gary Shapiro, president and CEO, CEA.

On Tuesday evening, January 6, the official press event 'CES Unveiled' was held at the Sands Expo and Convention Center/The Venetian. The event hosted a record number of more than 900 media, which was a 10 percent increase over the 2008 event. Product debuts continued on Wednesday, January 7 with CES' Press Day, which featured 11 exhibitor press conferences including Samsung, LG, Sony, Panasonic, Sharp, Toshiba and more.

Steve Ballmer, CEO of Microsoft Corp. delivered a pre-CES keynote address on Wednesday, January 7, 2009, at 6:30 p.m. Sir Howard Stringer, Chairman and CEO of Sony Corporation, kicked off the 2009 International CES on Thursday, January 8, with an opening keynote address, following a State of the CE Industry Address delivered by Gary Shapiro, president and CEO, CEA.
(Picture: Steve Ballmer, CEO of Microsoft Corp.)
